leadText:
An old woman (Japanese: オババ hag) is a character of the day who appeared in The Keystone Pops!. This article will refer to her by her title, as she was unnamed in the episode.

The old woman is a citizen of the village closest to the Hallowed Tower. When was let loose by and his , this woman told him and the tale of Spiritomb, and how the Aura Guardian sealed him away. The group decided they would help seal Spiritomb away just like in the legend, and the old woman followed them, occasionally giving advice.

However, she displayed some anger towards the group at first when finding out that it was them who smashed the towers. She believes to be "dumber than they look."
